name: Soyuz MS-28
about: Soyuz MS-28 (2025-275A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2025 Nov 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2025 Nov 28), held fixed
docked to A07725; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
